name: vertical_larks_head_knot
title: Vertical lark's head knot
about: Half hitches tied down a filler cord, the first in front of it and the next behind it, and so on: each pair is a lark's head knot, and a row of them makes a flat band with a ridge down one side. Shown loose and flat, two lark's heads.

steps.caption: Hang the filler cord straight down.
A half hitch in front: take the working cord across over the filler, back under it, and over its own standing part.
A half hitch behind, below the first: across under the filler, back over it, and under its own standing part. The two together are one lark's head knot.
A front hitch again: over the filler, back under it, over its own standing part.
And a back hitch: under the filler, back over it, under its own standing part. Two lark's head knots, one below the other.
